summary: Resolved the witness/ReadIndex eligibility question with the captured contract rather than inference: config.config.go documents a witness as a Raft node without log replication or a state machine, referencing Ongaro thesis 11.7.2, and forbids witness snapshots and the observer role. Since votingMembers() counts witnesses, hinted heartbeats reach them, and their echoes are counted toward quorum-1, witness support for read confirmation follows from the documented voter role; requesters still wait for their own applied index, so witnesses never supply entries. Marked the investigation explained with defect_claim refuted, answered the registered gap as resolved, and recorded the documented role as knowledge, with the witness-only read availability and experimental-status limits stated. No execution was run.
